svg.text: Galaxy map: every system, with its ID in docs/galaxy.md
with its distance in light years.
A jump reaches at most 10 ly, and no
two systems lie 10 to 11 ly apart.
Number in a system: how many
systems are in jump range (4 to 6).
Dashed circle: the outer ring, 28 ly
from the middle. A dashed ring around a
system: outside it, so the game can start there.
She is then on the far half of the map,
Jumps from start to her: 6 to 11
